Operation =1
Option =0
Begin InputTables
    Name ="Customers"
    Name ="Orders"
End
Begin OutputColumns
    Expression ="Customers.Company"
    Alias ="Total"
    Expression ="Sum(Orders.Amount)"
    Alias ="Unpaid"
    Expression ="Sum(IIf([Paid],0,[Amount]))"
    Alias ="Last order"
    Expression ="Max(Orders.[Order Date])"
End
Begin Joins
    LeftTable ="Customers"
    RightTable ="Orders"
    Expression ="Customers.ID = Orders.Customer"
    Flag =2
End
Begin OrderBy
    Expression ="Sum(Orders.Amount)"
    Flag =1
End
Begin Groups
    Expression ="Customers.Company"
    GroupLevel =0
End
dbBoolean "ReturnsRecords" ="-1"
dbInteger "ODBCTimeout" ="60"
